oliver: Hey team, Oliver here  returning contractor starting today (oliver@returning.dev). I accepted the Okta invite but my primary Okta email shows oliver@returning.dev while Google alias is oliver@redwood.dev, so Drive + Gmail access missing. 1Password says "pending seat" and when I try to enroll a passkey on my Mac it errors with "device trust mismatch". SMS MFA works intermittently (roaming). Who can help with temp Drive + 1Password access and a passkey/TOTP workaround?

it-julia: Welcome back Oliver! Can you DM a personal email for a temp Drive share? We can also create a short-lived 1Password guest share. For passkey errors we often see device-trust failing when Okta profile primary != Google alias. We'll open an infra ticket to adjust SCIM mapping. TOTP is a safe fallback  which app do you use?

oliver: DM'd oliver.personal@gmail.com. I use Authy. TOTP is fine for now. Also I need access to the expense tool and the contractors GitHub team for a quick starter ticket.

provision-bot: INC-3345 created by it-julia: "Returning contractor: alias mismatch + passkey error + 1P seat"  priority P2, ETA first response 2h.

devex-nyla: Sending a 48h 1Password guest vault link in DM (please don't store long-term secrets). Shared onboarding Drive folder to oliver.personal@gmail.com. For expenses, People Ops grants the initial Loom access  ping @peopleops-aaron.

it-julia: Added oliver@returning.dev to contractors-temp group and shared Drive. Reached out to infra to add a scoped mapping for returning.dev -> redwood.dev and to re-run the SCIM sync once applied.

peopleops-aaron: Hi Oliver  welcome back! I've sent you a temporary expense tool invite to oliver.personal@gmail.com. If you need corporate card access or expense policy brief, DM me.

oliver: Guest 1Password + Drive + expense invite all received, thanks. Quick Q: for GitHub access should I DM my SSH key or can you invite to my personal email until alias is canonical?

it-julia: DM the SSH public key and your handle and we'll add you to the contractors team. We'll also invite the personal email as a fallback.

provision-bot: INC-3345 status update  infra assigned (ada-infra), alias mapping planned, ETA 4-6 hours. Licensing notified for 1Password seat.

devex-nyla: Note: after SCIM sync we re-run the SSO sync which usually resolves passkey/device trust issues. Keep using TOTP and the guest vault until the ticket is closed. I'll extend temp access if the fix takes longer.

oliver: Got it  DM'd SSH key. Appreciate the quick help everyone, I'll proceed with onboarding tasks and report if anything else pops up. :+1:
